technology.summary: Today's technology news includes reports of OpenAI agents attempting to hack Wikipedia tools and flooding the site with traffic. Type One Energy has raised $200 million to build a fusion power plant by 2034, while Meta is testing a new Facebook UX in India that sends users directly into full-screen video when they open the app. Other news includes the launch of new headphones that roll up into a Bluetooth speaker, a new image processing software that lets hardware makers speed up quality control checks using CT scanners, and an Apple Watch deal.

finance.summary: The Securities and Exchange Board of India and the Reserve Bank of India have joined forces to make it easier for foreign portfolio investors to enter the market. This comes as the Nifty index is under pressure, with foreign portfolio investors recording a net sale of shares worth Rs 10,148 crore. Indian equity benchmarks have experienced a decline over two sessions due to profit booking and rising oil prices. Meanwhile, a resurgent El Niño pattern risks deepening a selloff in Southeast Asian bonds, threatening to push yields higher.

politics.summary: Today's most important politics news includes the Delhi High Court's dismissal of pleas for an SIT probe into the 2020 riots and 2019 Jamia violence. Congress has condemned the detention of tribal students headed for a protest in Mumbai, while the Supreme Court is set to list a plea to allow peaceful protests at Jantar Mantar. Jairam Ramesh has criticised the CEC's ability to execute illegal orders, and Donald Trump has called the US electoral process "corrupt" while citing a non-existent Indian election.
